name: Camposaurus
sum: Late Triassic coelophysid from Arizona known from lower leg bones, regarded as the oldest known neotheropod.
wsnote: Estimated at 3 m in Wikipedia revision 1370809209 from fragmentary material.
holotype: UCMP 34498 (distal tibiae, distal fibulae and astragalocalcanea) — Placerias quarry, Bluewater Creek Formation, Arizona.
biology: A small carnivorous theropod with fused tibio-tarsals and fibulo-tarsals like other coelophysids.
author: Hunt et al. 1998

images.artist: Sterling J. Nesbitt and Martín D. Ezcurra
images.caption: Holotype ankle bones of Camposaurus.
